CivicPort v0.14 release qualification record
===========================================

Scope
-----
- Preserve v0.13 narrow FAA/SWIM runway-closure mapping generation:
  faa.swim.aim-fns.notam-runway-closure/0.1
- Add durable-journal projection/diagnostics.
- Add read-only NoSQLServer NOTAM relation snapshot.
- Add Runtime Registry NOTAM evidence contract.
- Rebase queue-ingress dependency evidence to consolidated JMS Queue Bridge
  0.1-dev7-fb1 while consuming only its unchanged Java-neutral TEXT handoff.
- Add no NOTAM HardWorld promotion and no operational-use semantics.

Focused v0.14 acceptance
------------------------
PASS test_notam_surface_boundary_v014

Important focused assertions:
- supported + unsupported journal records => one typed projection + one explicit diagnostic;
- diagnostic retains exact Civic journal record/source identity and failure stage;
- first SQL SELECT freezes the journal snapshot;
- later journal appends do not mutate the materialized relation;
- a fresh relation sees later durable evidence;
- Runtime input accepts only source_identity and rejects queue/journal/JMS/URL/credential selectors;
- numeric-looking YYMMDDHHMM tokens are explicit JsonString values;
- no numeric coercion, DateTime construction, century/timezone inference or active-state calculation;
- SQL/Runtime output carries NOT_FOR_OPERATIONAL_USE and
  EVIDENCE_ONLY_NOT_FOR_OPERATIONAL_USE;
- no JMS provider, Secret Broker lease, Queue claim/ACK/NACK, HardWorld or
  promotion authority appears in the new v0.14 NOTAM surface files.

Complete deterministic suite
----------------------------
The environment execution ceiling interrupts the monolithic runner during an
inherited slow NoSQL batch. Qualification therefore ran the same run_tests.sh
surface in deterministic continuation batches from the interrupted test.

Result across the complete surface:
  PASS 81
  FAIL 0
  SKIP 4 optional live-network probes

The four skips are:

Fixture honesty
---------------
The FAA/SWIM AIM-FNS JYR XML is synthetic deterministic fixture data. It is not
a live FAA capture and the package does not claim operational suitability.
